Free LLM API resources

Note

Please don't abuse these services, else we might lose them.

aiSummary.oneLiner: Comprehensive directory of services offering free access or trial credits for LLM APIs.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This repository curates a continually updated list of legitimate platforms providing free tiers or trial credits for accessing Large Language Models via API. It specifically filters out unauthorized or reverse-engineered services to ensure developers use reliable, official endpoints. The list categorizes providers into those offering perpetual free tiers (like OpenRouter or Google AI Studio) and those providing generous sign-up credits, detailing their rate limits and available models.
keyFeatures: Feature: Lists legitimate providers offering free LLM API access.
Feature: Separates perpetual free tiers from trial credit offers.
Feature: Details rate limits (requests per minute/day) and token limits for each service.
Feature: Excludes unauthorized or reverse-engineered API wrappers.
Feature: Covers major providers like Google, Mistral, and HuggingFace, plus specialized gateways.

useCases.title: Prototyping AI Apps
useCases.description: Indie developers can build and test LLM-powered applications without incurring upfront API costs.

useCases.title: Model Evaluation
useCases.description: Researchers can test prompts across different inference providers (e.g., Cerebras, Groq) using free credits before committing to a platform.

useCases.title: Hobbyist Projects
useCases.description: Students can integrate AI features into personal projects by leveraging platforms with generous free daily request limits.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Indie developers, students, and researchers looking for cost-effective ways to integrate language models into their applications.
aiSummary.gettingStarted: Browse the README to find a provider matching your requirements and limits.
